title: Interview with Martine Neddam, Amsterdam, 28 February 2019
descriptions: These interviews were held as part of the interviewer’s Masters’ thesis that examined the acquisition of a version of Martine Neddam’s internet artwork Mouchette.org by the Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam and the MOTI museum (now Stedelijk Museum Breda). This interview includes an overview of the artist’s recollections about the early internet, how it influenced her making process for Mouchette.org and the decision-making that influenced the compilation of the version that was acquired.
